description.value: WildPlay Element Park is an outdoor adventure park near the Nanaimo River offering aerial obstacle courses through the forest canopy, ziplines, a bungy jump, a giant primal swing, and axe throwing. The park features multiple course difficulty levels—including a kids' course and an extreme course reaching 60 feet high—and is part of a multi-location BC chain. It makes for a memorable active detour for touring cyclists seeking an adrenaline break mid-route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for wildplay.com/nanaimo confirms an active, open adventure park with aerial obstacle courses, ziplines, a bungy jump, and a giant swing. The Plan Your Visit and FAQ pages mention bringing water bottles with drinks and snacks sold at Guest Services, and the FAQ references lockers for storing valuables. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears in the website content.
